comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record removes a cork while the bottle stays in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise blade insertion and combined wire-tool withdrawal versus corkscrew engagement, rotational actuation, and axial cork pulling while constraining the bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without connector damage versus cork fully out and at least 6 cm from the mouth while bottle displacement and rotation stay limited.
comparison.reason: Both extract retained parts, but their engagement, actuation, stabilization, and damage modes test different abilities.
